Subject: Post-demo: FintechCo performance/SLO recap & MAP items

Thanks again for the time today, Alex 

really appreciate the thoughtful questions and the demo feedback. Quick recap from our side and proposed next steps so we stay aligned on performance expectations and the mutual action plan (MAP).

Recap of performance requirements we discussed (please confirm / correct):
- P95 latency target for short responses (~32 tokens): 150ms target (you mentioned 200ms tolerable for non-critical endpoints).
- Streaming: required for live chat (low-latency chunks; target chunk latency <100ms).
- Peak concurrency: ~250 concurrent user sessions (avg ~80).
- Throughput: ~4k requests/min peak.
- Typical request size: ~100-150 tokens in / 60-120 tokens out (please confirm with traces).

Proposed MAP items & owners:
1) Redwood: run a 2-week pilot benchmark (hosted or dedicated) using a representative prompt set + traces you provide. Deliverables: latency/throughput report (p50/p90/p95), resource utilization, and recommended deployment/quantization profile. (Owner: Marissa / Dylan)
2) FintechCo: share request traces (anonymized), sample prompts, and a list of endpoints that require streaming vs batch. (Owner: Alex)
3) Procurement: share contracting timeline & any standard MSA clauses to surface early. (Owner: Alex / Procurement)
4) Joint: Kickoff benchmark + sync to review results and decision criteria (date proposal below).

Attachments: fintechco_slo_checklist.pdf, perf_test_template.xlsx (attached - template for payloads/expected traffic).

Questions for you before we kick off the pilot:
- Can you confirm the hard P95 target (150ms) vs the relaxed target (200ms) and which endpoints fall into each bucket?
- Confirm peak concurrency (250) is simultaneous streaming sessions or inference requests per second?
- Any regulatory constraints for data residency or audit logs we should account for during the pilot?

Proposed next meeting: Wed, Aug 12 at 10:00 AM PT for a 30-45m kickoff to go over traces and finalize pilot scope.

Thanks - I'll wait for the traces and procurement timeline and we'll land the kickoff once we have those.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Thanks Marissa - great summary. A few clarifications from our side:
- P95: we can commit to 150ms for the 'critical' endpoints (auth, fraud-check, real-time quoting). For broader conversational endpoints, 200ms is acceptable.
- Concurrency: 250 = simultaneous streaming sessions (we use streaming for chat). Avg concurrent ~80 during business hours; peak windows are short but can spike.
- Throughput: expect up to ~4k req/min at peak.
- Typical tokens: about 120 tokens in, 90 tokens out on average.
- Streaming behavior: chunk sizes are typically 20-40 tokens; we need chunk latencies below 100ms to keep the UI snappy.

We'll send anonymized traces and a sample prompt set by EOD Thurs (Aug 13). Procurement timeline: aiming for contract execution by Sep 1. I'm looping in procurement@fintechco.com for visibility.

Two quick questions:
1) For the 2-week pilot, what does Redwood need from us to run the benchmark (format of traces/payloads, test windows)?
2) Ballpark: given the targets above, should we expect to run this on Hosted with reserved capacity or will Dedicated capacity be required? Looking for a pricing order-of-magnitude to present to Finance.

On the kickoff: Wed Aug 12 10:00 AM PT works for me - I'll be on the call.

Best,
Alex Johnson
Head of Platform Engineering | FintechCo
alex.johnson@fintechco.com
+1 (650) 555-0789

Thanks - adding a few technical notes from the SE side to help scope the pilot.

Short answers to Alex's questions:
- For the pilot we'll need anonymized HTTP request/response traces (JSON), a representative prompt set (CSV or JSONL), and an estimate of tokenization (you provided a good baseline ~120 in / 90 out). We've attached perf_test_template.xlsx to make mapping straightforward.
- Deployment recommendation: for sustained 250 concurrent streaming sessions with p95 ~150ms we typically recommend a reserved/dedicated pool (predictable throughput + isolation). Hosted with aggressive autoscaling can work for short pilots but may cost more at scale and add variability to p95. We'll model both in the benchmark.
- Quick sizing note (very rough): assuming average response length and chunking, plan for capacity that supports ~250 concurrent streaming contexts; we'll produce GPU vRam / instance count guidance in the benchmark report.

Questions for FintechCo:
- Can you provide typical client-side chunk interval (how often clients send partials) and expected max tokens per chunk?
- Any endpoints where you can tolerate higher latency (200ms) vs the 150ms hard SLO? Call those out so we can set test SLAs.

We'll prepare a short benchmark runbook + MAP doc before the kickoff so we can get alignment on success criteria.

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
